result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up convergence review for prior blockers S0-F1, S0-F2, and S0-F3, plus directly touched logging, derivation, work-queue, storage, public view, inspect, and thread-view surfaces. Confirmed TC-5.1a through TC-5.5a coverage and reran the targeted logging test, story gate, and epic gate.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: Production fallback paths now write log events from derive.ts via logFallback and writeLog, while ready derivation completion clears persisted gaps in work-queue complete. The ready turn and chunk writes in derive.ts no longer attach gaps to successful derivation rows. TC-5.3a now exercises a real fallback derivation path and asserts the ready row has gaps null while the fallback event is queryable from log.

writeLog no longer inserts through the caller db handle. It resolves the tracked database path, opens a separate database connection, inserts the log row fail-soft, and closes that connection. storage.ts tracks paths for openDatabase handles, fixtures route raw test handles through that opener, and logging-surface includes real-store rollback containment coverage.

Current public/shared and thread-view shapes now expose derivationUsed, derivationCounts, and usedDerivation. thread_view JSON persistence writes the renamed keys, storage v7 migrates old persisted JSON keys, and rg found no live formUsed, formCounts, FormSnapshot, or FormLookup references outside migration compatibility strings.

verified: AC-5.1 / TC-5.1a: logging-surface.test.ts persists info, warning, and error log entries.
AC-5.2 / TC-5.2a: internal writeLog and sdk.logging.write both write to the same durable log table.
AC-5.3 / TC-5.3a: production fallback derivation logs reason not_ready and leaves ready derivation rows without fallback markers.
AC-5.3 / TC-5.3b: failed derivation state still records failure reason on the derivation row.
AC-5.4 / TC-5.4a: log queries filter by level, derivationType, subjectId, and reason.
AC-5.5 / TC-5.5a: log write failures are contained and do not abort caller work.
DD-5 transaction rule: writeLog uses a separate database connection rather than the caller transaction.
Story 0 derivation vocabulary DoD: current public/shared view, inspect, thread-view rendering, and persisted thread_view JSON use derivation vocabulary.
Story gate passed: cd packages/lhc && pnpm run verify.
Epic gate passed: cd packages/lhc && pnpm run verify-all.

gatesRun.command: cd packages/lhc && pnpm exec vitest run test/logging-surface.test.ts

additionalObservations: verify and verify-all both reported 42 test files passed, 396 tests passed, and 9 real-inference tests skipped because LHC_OPENROUTER_KEY is unset; the configured gates exited successfully.
